creator: Claude
name: Kitchen Base Unit
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 5 cm cells (the library's furniture/prop tier): real member thicknesses (boards, rails, cushions, doors) stay believable instead of toy-like; matches the game's 0.05 m character rig.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the occupied footprint at ground level.
front_note: +Y is the side a person uses (seat, doors, drawers, controls).
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude palette v2 (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Box matching dimensions_m, centred on the pivot.
story: The everyday prep counter beside the cooker. The left drawer, where the cutlery lived, was yanked open by someone looking for a knife and left out; the paint is rubbed through to the wood where hands pulled the doors for years.
notes: Shares the kitchen run rhythm: worktop top 0.90 m, 0.65 m deep, same doors, handles and toe kick as Claude_kitchen_sink and Claude_wall_cabinet.
Width 1.25 m (25 cells, two 0.60 m doors and a centre reveal) against GPT's 1.26 m reference.

verification.magicavoxel_gui_open: unverified (MagicaVoxel not available in the build environment)
verification.godot_import: unverified (Godot not available in the build environment)
